_doc: Latest publicly reported valuations of large private AI companies. Funding-round valuations are set by investors in that round and are not comparable to public market caps. Reviewed at each scheduled refresh; every row needs a source link.

companies.name: Anthropic
companies.note: No longer private: priced its IPO at $83 a share and began trading November 19. About $1.49T fully diluted (Financial Times; other outlets report lower figures); at least $68B raised in the IPO plus a $26B private placement. Last private round: $965B (Series H, May 2026).

companies.name: OpenAI
companies.note: Largest private round on record. Later reported talks at higher valuations were not confirmed.

companies.name: xAI
companies.note: No longer a standalone private company: combined with SpaceX (reported $250B), which then went public in June 2026.

companies.name: Cursor (Anysphere)
companies.note: Acquired in an all-stock deal; completed August 14.
